bio_en: Kshitiz Thebe, a candidate of the CPN-UML, was born in Sinam of ward 1 of Sirijangha Rural Municipality in Taplejung. He is the youngest son of Bhupendra Thebe and Urmila Thebe. He completed his School Leaving Certificate from Sinam Secondary School in his village and later moved to Kathmandu for higher studies, completing his bachelor’s degree there.Coming from a political family background, Thebe began his political journey through the ANNFSU, the student wing of the CPN-UML. He later served as a central member, secretary and vice-chair of the Youth Association, and was twice elected its central chair. He became a member of the party’s provincial committee and was elected a central committee member at the party’s recent general convention. This is his first time contesting an election for public office.Thebe is married and has a son. He is the youngest among four siblings, with one elder brother and two elder sisters.His father, Bhupendra, was elected a Constituent Assembly member in the second Constituent Assembly election, while his mother, Urmila, became a lawmaker in 2022 through the UML’s proportional representation list.

Gajendra Prasad Tumyang was born in 2036 BS in Khewang of ward 7 of Sirijangha Rural Municipality, Taplejung. He has been continuously involved in the political journey of the Nepali Congress and has not pursued any other profession so far.He began his political career through the Nepal Students’ Union, the student wing of the Nepali Congress, starting from the unit committee at Ganesh Secondary School in Khewang. He later became district president of the Nepal Students’ Union, secretary of the Nepali Congress District Working Committee, and eventually district president of the party.Tumyang passed his SLC from Ganesh Secondary School. He also served as chair of the Pathibhara Campus Management Committee. During his tenure, he organised a week-long religious recital to raise funds and upgraded the campus from offering bachelor’s level studies to master’s level. He has also served as executive director of the Pathibhara Area Development Committee. This is his first attempt in a parliamentary election.Tumyang is married and has two daughters.

Khel Prasad Buda Chhetri , born in 1975 in Pedang of ward 5 of Sirijanga Rural Municipality in Taplejung, is a central committee member of the Communist Party of Nepal.In the 2022 election, he was defeated by CPN-UML’s Yogesh Kumar Bhattarai by just 220 votes.Having studied up to the Intermediate of Science level, he taught at a school in his village. While still in the teaching profession, he joined the armed conflict and spent a long period underground.

bio_en: Budha is a central member of the CPN (Unified Socialist) and Dolpa In-charge of the party. He was elected from the district in the Constituent Assembly elections held in 2070 BS. Budha, who was reelected in 2074 BS, became Minister for Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation in the same year. He joined the CPN (Unified Socialist) following the UML's split in 2078 BS.

Former Chief Minister of Karnali province, Mahendra Bahadur Shahi started his political journey from CPN Masal (Ekata Kendra) in 2048 BS. Shahi is a standing committee member of the CPN (Maoist Center). He was elected from Kalikot-1 (1) in the 2074 BS elections and became the Chief Minister of Karnali Province. He was also elected from Kalikot-1 in the 2070 BS Constituent Assembly elections. Shahi, who started politics in 2048 BS, also participated in the 'people's war' by the then CPN (Maoist). He also became a division commander during the armed conflict.

Thapa started his political journey in 2028 BS. He joined CPN-UML in 2049 BS and was elected the party's district secretary in 2074 BS. Thapa became the party's district chairman in 2065 BS. He became Karnali Province chairman of the CPN (Unified Socialist) following the party split in 2078 BS.He was elected constituent assembly member in 2070 BS and province assembly member in the 2074 elections. Thapa served as the Minister for Physical Infrastructure for six months in 2077 BS.

bio_en: Incumbent Minister for Finance Janardan Sharma entered into politics in 2034 BS. He became central committee member of the then CPN (Maoist) in 2056 BS and a politburo member in 2057 BS. He was as picked division commander of the 'people's army' in 2060 BS. He was elected standing committee member of the party in 2070 BS. In 2075 BS, Sharma became a standing committee member of the then Nepal Communist Party and Karnali Province In-charge.He was a lawmaker in the interim parliament of 2063 BS. Sharma was elected in the constituent assembly elections held in 2064 BS and 2070 BS and reelected in the 2074 polls from Rukum West.Sharma was Minister for Peace and Reconstruction in 2065 BS, Minister for Energy in 2073 BS, Minister for Home Affairs in 2074 BS and was appointed Finance Minister in 2078 BS.
